q.en: Who was the prophet to whom the word of the LORD came?
Micah was from which town?
In the days of which kings of Judah did Micah prophesy?
q.ml: മീഖാ ഏതു രാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ കാലത്തു ദർശനം പ്രാപിച്ചു?

q.en: How many kings of Judah are named in Micah's days?
q.ta: மீகாவின் நாட்களில் எத்தனை யூதா ராஜாக்கள் சொல்லப்பட்டுள்ளனர்?

q.en: Concerning which two cities did Micah see the vision?
q.ta: மீகா எந்த இரண்டு பட்டணங்களுக்கு விரோதமாய்த் தரிசித்தான்?

q.en: Whom does Micah call to hear his message?
Who will be a witness against the people?
From where will the Lord be witness against them?
What will the LORD do from his place?
Upon what will the LORD tread?

a.en: The high places of the earth

q.en: What will melt under the LORD?
What will happen to the valleys before the LORD?
The mountains melt like what before the fire?
For whose transgression is all this happening?
What is the transgression of Jacob according to Micah?
What are the high places of Judah?
What will the LORD make Samaria like?
Samaria will be made like the plantings of what?
Into where will the LORD pour down the stones of Samaria?
What will be beaten to pieces in Samaria?
With what will the hires of Samaria be burned?
Samaria gathered her wealth from the hire of whom?
How will Micah go because of this?
Micah will wail like what animals?
Micah will mourn like what birds?
What is incurable?
The wound has come as far as which city?
At which city should they not declare it?
In which house were they to roll in the dust?
Who is told to pass away with shame naked?
q.ta: வெட்கத்துடன் அப்பாலே போகச் சொல்லப்பட்டவள் எந்த ஊரில் குடியிருக்கிறவள்?

q.en: Whose mourning is mentioned along with the inhabitant of Zaanan?
q.ta: சாயனானில் குடியிருக்கிறவனோடு எந்த இடத்தின் புலம்பல் சொல்லப்பட்டது?
q.ml: സയനാൻ നിവാസികളോടൊപ്പം ഏതു സ്ഥലത്തിന്റെ വിലാപം പറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു?

q.en: Who waited carefully for good?
q.ta: நன்மை வருமென்று எதிர்பார்த்திருந்தவள் எந்த ஊரில் குடியிருக்கிறவள்?

q.en: What came down from the LORD to the gate of Jerusalem?
Which inhabitants were told to bind the chariot to the swift beast?
q.ta: வேகமான குதிரைகளை இரதத்திலே பூட்டச் சொல்லப்பட்டவள் எங்கே குடியிருக்கிறவள்?
q.ml: രഥത്തിന്നു തുരഗങ്ങളെ കെട്ടാൻ പറഞ്ഞതു ഏതു നഗരനിവാസികളോടു?

q.en: Lachish was the beginning of sin to whom?
To which place shall Lachish give presents?
The houses of which place shall be a lie to the kings of Israel?
q.ta: இஸ்ரவேலின் ராஜாக்களுக்கு அபத்தமாய்ப்போகும் வீடுகள் எந்த ஊரினுடையவை?

q.en: To which inhabitant will the LORD bring an heir?
The glory of Israel shall come unto which place?
What were they told to do for their delicate children?
Their baldness should be enlarged like what bird?
Woe to those who devise what upon their beds?
When do the wicked practise their evil?
Why do they practise evil in the morning?

a.en: It is in the power of their hand

q.en: What do they covet and take by violence?
What else do they covet and take away besides fields?
q.ml: വയലുകളെ കൂടാതെ അവർ മോഹിച്ചു കൈക്കലാക്കുന്നതു എന്തു?

q.en: Whose heritage do they oppress?
What does the LORD devise against this family?
q.ta: கர்த்தர் இந்த வம்சத்துக்கு விரோதமாய் என்ன நினைக்கிறார்?
q.ml: യഹോവ ഈ വംശത്തിന്റെ നേരെ എന്തു നിരൂപിക്കുന്നു?

q.en: What shall they not remove from the evil?
How shall they not walk, because the time is evil?
In that day what shall one take up against them?
What shall they say they are in that day?
q.ta: அவர்கள் அந்நாளில் தாங்கள் எப்படி ஆனோம் என்று சொல்வார்கள்?
q.ml: അവർ അന്നാളിൽ തങ്ങൾക്കു എന്തു ഭവിച്ചു എന്നു പറയും?

q.en: What has the LORD changed, as they lament?
In whose congregation will there be none to cast a cord by lot?
q.ml: ആരുടെ സഭയിൽ അളവുനൂൽ പിടിപ്പാൻ ആരും ഉണ്ടാകയില്ല?

q.en: What did they tell the prophets not to do?
Whose words do good to him that walketh uprightly?
q.ta: செம்மையாய் நடக்கிறவனுக்கு யாருடைய வார்த்தைகள் நன்மை செய்யும்?

q.en: To whom do the LORD's words do good?
Whom did God's people rise up against as an enemy?
What did they pull off from those passing by?
Whom did they cast out from their pleasant houses?
What did they take away from the children forever?
What were the people told to do?
Why is the land not their rest?
About what did the false prophet say he would prophesy?
q.ml: വ്യാജം പറയുന്നവൻ എന്തിനെക്കുറിച്ചു പ്രസംഗിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു?

q.en: Whom will the LORD surely gather?
The LORD will put them together like the sheep of where?
q.ta: கர்த்தர் அவர்களை எந்த ஊரின் ஆடுகளைப்போல் கூட்டுவார்?
q.ml: യഹോവ അവരെ ഏതു സ്ഥലത്തെ ആടുകളെപ്പോലെ കൂട്ടും?

q.en: Who goes up before them?
Who will pass before the people at their head?
To whom did Micah say, "Hear, I pray you," in the first verse?

a.en: Heads of Jacob, princes of Israel

q.en: What are the heads of Jacob supposed to know?
What do the leaders hate?
What do the leaders love?
What do they pluck from the people's bones?
Whose flesh do the leaders eat?
What do they break of the people?
Into what do they chop the people like flesh?
To whom will they cry?
What will the LORD hide from them at that time?
Why will the LORD hide his face from them?

a.en: They behaved themselves ill in their doings

q.en: Concerning whom does the LORD speak in verse five?

a.en: The prophets that make my people err

q.en: What do the false prophets cry when they have food to bite?
Against whom do they prepare war?

a.en: He that putteth not into their mouths

q.en: What shall come to the prophets so they shall not have a vision?
What shall go down over the prophets?
What shall be dark over the prophets?
Who shall be ashamed?
Who shall be confounded?
What will they all cover?
Why will the seers cover their lips?

a.en: There is no answer of God

q.en: By what is Micah full of power?
What is Micah full of besides power?
What did Micah declare to Jacob?
What did Micah declare to Israel?
What do the heads of Jacob abhor?
What do they pervert?
With what do they build up Zion?
With what do they build up Jerusalem?
For what do the heads of Jerusalem judge?
For what do the priests teach?
For what do the prophets divine?
Upon whom do they lean, saying none evil can come upon us?
q.ml: അവർ ആരെ ചാരി അനർത്ഥം വരികയില്ല എന്നു പറയുന്നു?

q.en: What shall Zion be plowed like?
What shall Jerusalem become?
The mountain of the house shall be like what?

a.en: The high places of the forest

q.en: In which days shall the mountain of the LORD's house be established?
q.ta: கர்த்தருடைய ஆலயமாகிய பர்வதம் எந்த நாட்களில் ஸ்தாபிக்கப்படும்?
q.ml: യഹോവയുടെ ആലയമുള്ള പർവ്വതം ഏതു കാലത്തു സ്ഥാപിതമാകും?

q.en: The mountain of the LORD's house shall be established where?

a.en: In the top of the mountains

q.en: Who shall flow unto the mountain of the LORD?
Whom will the many nations call the God of the house to which they go?
q.ta: திரளான ஜாதிகள் யாருடைய தேவனுடைய ஆலயத்துக்குப் போவோம் என்பார்கள்?
q.ml: അനേകവംശങ്ങൾ ആരുടെ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ആലയത്തിലേക്കു കയറിച്ചെല്ലാം എന്നു പറയും?

q.en: What will the LORD teach the nations?
Out of where shall the law go forth?
From where shall the word of the LORD go forth?
What shall they beat their swords into?
What shall they beat their spears into?
What shall nation not lift up against nation?
q.ta: ஒரு ஜாதிக்கு விரோதமாய் மறுஜாதி எதை எடுப்பதில்லை?

q.en: What shall they not learn any more?
Where shall every man sit?

a.en: Under his vine and under his fig tree

q.en: Who shall make them afraid?
Whose mouth has spoken this promise?
In whose name will all people walk?
q.ta: சகல ஜனங்களும் யாருடைய நாமத்தைப் பற்றிக்கொண்டு நடப்பார்கள்?

q.en: In whose name will we walk forever and ever?
Whom will the LORD assemble in that day?
Whom else will the LORD gather?
What will the LORD make of her that halted?
What will the LORD make of her that was cast far off?
Over them in which mount shall the LORD reign?
What shall come to the daughter of Jerusalem?
What did the daughter of Zion have like a woman in travail?
q.ta: சீயோன் குமாரத்திக்கு பிரசவிக்கிற ஸ்திரீக்கு ஒத்த என்ன உண்டாகும்?
q.ml: സീയോൻ പുത്രിക്കു ഈറ്റുനോവു കിട്ടിയവളെപ്പോലെ എന്തു ഉണ്ടായി?

q.en: Where must the daughter of Zion go?
Where shall she be delivered?
From whose hand will the LORD redeem her?
What did the many nations say about Zion?
What do the nations not know?
The LORD will gather them like what into the floor?
What will the LORD make the horn of the daughter of Zion?
What will the LORD make her hoofs?
To whom will she consecrate the gain of many people?
Whom shall they smite with a rod upon the cheek?
With what shall they smite the judge of Israel?
Which town does the ruler of Israel come out of?
q.ta: இஸ்ரவேலை ஆளப்போகிறவர் எந்த ஊரிலிருந்து புறப்பட்டு வருவார்?

q.en: How is Bethlehem described among the thousands of Judah?
Over whom shall the one from Bethlehem be ruler?
How old are the goings forth of the ruler?
Until when will the LORD give them up?

a.en: Until she which travaileth hath brought forth

q.en: Who shall return unto the children of Israel?
In whose strength shall he stand and feed?
Unto where shall he be great?
Who shall be the peace?
Who shall come into our land and tread in our palaces?
q.ta: நம்முடைய தேசத்திலே வந்து அரண்மனைகளை மிதிப்பவன் யார்?
q.ml: നമ്മുടെ ദേശത്തു വന്നു അരമനകളിൽ ചവിട്ടുന്നതു ആർ?

q.en: How many shepherds shall be raised against the Assyrian?
How many principal men shall be raised along with the shepherds?
Which two lands shall they waste with the sword?
q.ta: அவர்கள் எந்த இரண்டு தேசங்களை பட்டயத்திற்கு இரையாக்குவார்கள்?
q.ml: അവർ ഏതു രണ്ടു ദേശങ്ങളെ വാൾകൊണ്ടു പാഴാക്കും?

q.en: With what shall they waste the land of Assyria?
The remnant of Jacob shall be like what from the LORD?
q.ta: யாக்கோபிலே மீதியானவர்கள் கர்த்தராலே வருகிற எதைப்போல இருப்பார்கள்?

q.en: The remnant of Jacob shall be like showers upon what?
The remnant of Jacob shall be like what among the beasts of the forest?
Among the flocks of sheep they shall be like what?
What shall be lifted up upon the adversaries?
What will the LORD cut off out of the midst of the people?
What else will the LORD destroy besides the horses?
What will the LORD cut off in the land?
What will the LORD throw down?
What will the LORD cut off out of their hand?
Who shall they have no more?
What will the LORD cut off out of the midst of them?
What shall they no more worship?
What will the LORD pluck up out of the midst of them?
Upon whom will the LORD execute vengeance in anger and fury?
q.ta: கர்த்தர் யாரிடத்திலே கோபத்தோடும் உக்கிரத்தோடும் நீதியைச் சரிக்கட்டுவார்?
q.ml: യഹോവ ആരോടു കോപത്തോടും ക്രോധത്തോടും പ്രതികാരം ചെയ്യും?

q.en: Before whom was Micah told to contend?
q.ta: மீகா யாருக்கு முன் வழக்கைச் சொல்ல வேண்டும்?

q.en: What should the hills hear?
What does the LORD have with his people?
With whom will the LORD plead?
What does the LORD ask his people he has done?
From which land did the LORD bring his people up?
q.ta: கர்த்தர் தம் ஜனத்தை எந்த தேசத்திலிருந்து வரப்பண்ணினார்?
q.ml: യഹോവ തന്റെ ജനത്തെ ഏതു ദേശത്തുനിന്നു പുറപ്പെടുവിച്ചു?

q.en: Out of what house did the LORD redeem them?
Which three did the LORD send before his people?
q.ta: கர்த்தர் தம் ஜனத்துக்கு முன்பாக அனுப்பிய மூவர் யார்?
q.ml: യഹോവ ജനത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ അയച്ച മൂന്നുപേർ ആർ?

q.en: Which king of Moab consulted against Israel?
Who was the son of Beor who answered Balak?
From which place unto Gilgal did events happen?
Why were the people told to remember these things?
Before whom does the speaker ask to bow himself?
Shall he come with what kind of offerings?
How old are the calves of the offering?
Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of what?
Will the LORD be pleased with ten thousands of what?
What would he give for his transgression?
What has the LORD shown man?
What does the LORD require of thee?
What are we to love according to Micah 6:8?
How are we to walk with our God?
q.ta: நம் தேவனுக்கு முன்பாக எப்படி நடக்க வேண்டும்?

q.en: What does the LORD's voice do unto the city?
q.ta: கர்த்தருடைய சத்தம் நகரத்தை நோக்கி என்ன செய்கிறது?

q.en: What is in the house of the wicked?
With what are the rich men full?
What have the inhabitants spoken?
Why will the LORD make them desolate?
To what will the LORD give up what they deliver?
What shall they sow but not do?
What shall they tread but not anoint with?
What will they tread but not drink?
Whose statutes are kept?
Whose house's works are followed along with Omri's statutes?
q.ta: உம்ரியின் கட்டளைகளோடு யாருடைய வீட்டாரின் செய்கைகள் கைக்கொள்ளப்படுகின்றன?
q.ml: ഒമ്രിയുടെ ചട്ടങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ ആരുടെ ഗൃഹത്തിന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തികൾ പ്രമാണമാക്കി?

q.en: Whose reproach shall they bear?
What kind of fruit did Micah's soul desire?
What is there no cluster of to eat?
Who is perished out of the earth?
For what do they all lie in wait?
With what do they hunt every man his brother?
What does the prince ask?
What does the judge ask for?
The best of them is like what?
What is sharper than a thorn hedge?
In whom must we not trust?
What must we keep from her that lieth in the bosom?
q.ta: உன் மடியில் படுத்துக்கொள்ளுகிறவளுக்கு முன்பாக எதை எச்சரிக்கையாயிருக்க வேண்டும்?

q.en: Who dishonoureth the father?
Who riseth up against her mother?
Who are a man's enemies?

a.en: The men of his own house

q.en: Unto whom will Micah look?
Who is the God Micah waits for?
When I fall, what shall I do?
Who shall be a light unto me when I sit in darkness?
What will Micah bear because he sinned against the LORD?
q.ta: மீகா கர்த்தருக்கு விரோதமாகப் பாவஞ்செய்ததால் எதைச் சுமப்பான்?

q.en: Whose righteousness shall Micah behold?
What did the enemy say to Micah?

a.en: Where is the LORD thy God?

q.en: The enemy shall be trodden down like what?
What is to be built in that day?
From which land shall they come to thee?
q.ml: ഏതു ദേശത്തുനിന്നു അവർ നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരും?

q.en: They shall come from sea to what?
Why shall the land be desolate?

a.en: Because of them that dwell therein

q.en: With what are the people to be fed?
In the midst of which mountain do they dwell solitarily?
q.ta: எந்த இடத்தின் நடுவிலே ஜனங்கள் தனித்து வனவாசமாயிருக்கிறார்கள்?

q.en: In which two places shall they feed as in the days of old?
From which land did they come out in the days of old?
What will the LORD show them?
What shall the nations lay upon their mouth?
What shall they lick like a serpent?
Of whom shall they be afraid?
Who is a God that pardoneth iniquity?
In what does the LORD delight?
How long does the LORD retain his anger?
Where will the LORD cast all our sins?

a.en: Into the depths of the sea

q.en: What will the LORD do to our iniquities?
To whom will the LORD perform the truth?
To whom will the LORD show mercy?
